title: Expose a verification producer's aggregate run outcome in the acceptance verification read, opt-in and versioned
outcome: Expose a verification producer's aggregate run outcome in the acceptance verification read, opt-in and versioned
acceptance: The host acceptance_verification_read can return, for each verification's producer, the stored aggregate run outcome (the producer's run_outcome) alongside the existing stage outcome, for portable and bound records; a host that does not opt in receives the unchanged current shape, so TermAl's strict parser keeps working
A behaviour test records a run whose aggregate failed with one passing stage and observes the read reporting the passing stage and the failed aggregate when opted in, and the current shape otherwise
